h1: B2B Lead Generation for Companies Selling to Shanghai
intro: Looking for a lead generation partner for Shanghai? Myntmore runs researched email outreach and ABM for companies that want buyers and partners in China, from multinationals' China offices to manufacturers and sourcing teams. We work remotely from Mumbai, campaigns go live within 18 days, and the first qualified conversations usually arrive in weeks 3 to 4.
whyTitle: Why selling to Shanghai needs outbound

why.title: China's commercial capital
why.desc: Shanghai holds the China headquarters of multinationals alongside manufacturers, biotech firms and trading companies, so one city covers many of the buyers that matter.

why.title: Different channels from the rest of the world
why.desc: LinkedIn plays a much smaller role in mainland China than elsewhere, so campaigns lean on email and target English-speaking roles at multinationals, sourcing offices and partners.

why.title: Strict data rules
why.desc: China's Personal Information Protection Law is stricter than most. Every campaign is scoped with you, and with counsel, before anything is sent.

stepsTitle: How B2B lead generation works with us

steps.title: ICP and buying signals

steps.title: Lists, domains and copy
steps.desc: Verified contact lists, dedicated sending domains with warm-up, and copy written for buyers in China, in English or Chinese as agreed.

steps.title: Campaigns go live
steps.desc: Cold email and LinkedIn sequences start sending in China business hours, with account-based plays for named companies.

steps.title: Conversations, then consistency
steps.desc: First qualified conversations usually come in weeks 3 to 4, and meeting volume becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8 as we tune messaging on real replies.
